Chemical residue above limit.provides: chronic risk, uniform across a production run, no acute illness

Primary production.provides: contamination present before any processing, affects everything downstream of that input

Processing plant.provides: wide distribution of the fault across a production run

Packaging line.provides: faults confined to what passed that line, labelling errors originate here

Retail handling.provides: faults confined to one store, no production record

Routine end-product testing.provides: detection before release, statistical coverage only

Consumer complaint.provides: detection of visible or immediately felt problems, product already sold

Public health surveillance.provides: detection of outbreaks weeks later, only for illness-causing agents

Supplier notification.requires: an upstream supplier discovering their own fault
Supplier notification.provides: early warning covering everything using that input

Single batch.requires: the fault traceable to identifiable units

All production from one plant.requires: a plant-wide cause or loss of traceability

All product of one brand.requires: an input used across the brand

No illness reported.requires: detection before consumption or a non-acute hazard

Fatalities.requires: a severe hazard reaching a vulnerable consumer

_v1_notes.CONTAMINANT|ORIGIN STAGE: an undeclared allergen originates at processing or packaging - a labelling or cross-contact fault - so primary production and retail are N. Foreign bodies are N at primary production as posed. Chemical residue is N at packaging and retail, arising from application or process carryover upstream.
_v1_notes.CONTAMINANT|DETECTION ROUTE: public health surveillance detects only illness-causing agents, so chemical residue is N and foreign bodies are N. Allergens are N for surveillance as an outbreak signal. Chemical residue is N for consumer complaint and N for surveillance.
_v1_notes.CONTAMINANT|RECALL SCOPE: a foreign body affects individual units, so plant-wide and brand-wide recalls are N.
_v1_notes.CONTAMINANT|HEALTH IMPACT: an allergen produces individual severe reactions, not a multi-region outbreak, so that is N. Foreign bodies are N for multi-region outbreak and N for fatalities as posed. Chemical residue is chronic, so localised cluster, outbreak and fatalities are all N.
_v1_notes.ORIGIN STAGE|DETECTION ROUTE: retail handling is N for routine end-product testing and N for supplier notification - no production record and no upstream supplier involvement. Processing and packaging are both N for supplier notification, the fault being their own.
_v1_notes.ORIGIN STAGE|RECALL SCOPE: packaging is N for brand-wide recall. Retail handling is N for plant-wide and brand-wide recalls, being confined to one store.
_v1_notes.ORIGIN STAGE|HEALTH IMPACT: retail handling is N for multi-region outbreak - one store cannot produce it.
_v1_notes.DETECTION ROUTE|RECALL SCOPE: public health surveillance is N for no-recall-required: if surveillance found it, product is in the market.
_v1_notes.DETECTION ROUTE|HEALTH IMPACT: routine testing and supplier notification both catch product before consumption, so cluster, outbreak and fatalities are N. Public health surveillance is N for no-illness-reported by definition.
